description: This file contains React functional components that implement UI elements such as Card, Button, Input, Textarea, Select, Badge, StatusBadge, SeverityBadge, Divider, and InlineSpinner. It defines reusable UI components for a frontend project.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: React component that renders a styled section wrapping its children.

methods.name: CardHeader
methods.description: React component for rendering a header section with title, optional subtitle, and optional right-side content.

methods.name: CardBody
methods.description: React component for rendering a styled content area inside a card.

methods.name: Button
methods.description: React component for rendering styled buttons with different variants and optional additional properties.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: React component for rendering labeled input fields with optional hint and error messages.

methods.name: Textarea
methods.description: React component for rendering labeled textarea fields with optional hint and error messages.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: React component for rendering labeled select dropdowns with optional hint and error messages.

methods.name: Badge
methods.description: React component for rendering badge labels with various color tones.

methods.name: SeverityBadge
methods.description: React component for rendering severity level badges based on severity values.

methods.name: StatusBadge
methods.description: React component for rendering defect status badges based on status values.

methods.name: Divider
methods.description: React component rendering a horizontal divider line.

methods.name: InlineSpinner
methods.description: React component showing a loading spinner with an optional label.
